_meta.test_split: official AVEC 2017 test split, no re-splitting
notes: Runs are not bit-exact across machines due to CUDA nondeterminism.
F1 = 0.000 at threshold 0.5 in runs 4-9 reflects class-prior miscalibration (28% positive class, no class weighting, no threshold tuning), not broken implementation.
Runs 1-3 avoid F1 = 0 by explicitly pushing probabilities up (class weights in 1 and 3, dev-threshold tuning in 2), at the cost of lower AUC.
AUC is the primary summary metric for this class distribution.
Session 440 is a corrupt archive on the server side and is excluded; it was in the dev split, so test is unaffected.
The test split is verified to contain 14 positives against full_test_split.csv; some AVEC companion docs cite 15, but the released CSV is authoritative.

runs.configuration: full encoder fine-tune + attention pooling + class weights + label smoothing
runs.notes: Catastrophic overfitting: train loss collapsed 0.52 -> 0.17 within 4 epochs (perfect-separation floor for this loss); dev AUC never exceeded 0.45.

runs.configuration: top-4 unfreeze + mean pooling + window cap + dev-threshold tuning
runs.notes: Epoch 1 hit dev AUC 0.688 (highest dev AUC in the project) then collapsed. Dev-tuned threshold 0.25 overfits 12-positive dev and does not transfer to test.

runs.configuration: frozen encoder + mean-pooled features + aggregated subject-level linear probe (class-weighted head)
runs.notes: 0.17 AUC gap between dev (0.696) and test (0.526). F1 nonzero because class-weighted head pushes positive probabilities up.

runs.configuration: fully frozen encoder + 768->256->2 MLP head, no class weights, no label smoothing
runs.notes: Best Wav2Vec2 AUC in the project. All probabilities below threshold 0.5 (class prior 28% with no weighting); F1 = 0 is a threshold-calibration artifact, not a broken run.

runs.configuration: 7s non-overlapping windows + layer summation + LayerNorm + SpecAugment time masking
runs.notes: Dev AUC rose monotonically (0.494 -> 0.557) but test AUC stayed near random. The three changes hurt jointly versus run 4.

runs.configuration: LoRA (r=8, alpha=16) on attention q_proj, v_proj + small MLP head
runs.notes: Train loss dropped and dev AUC rose monotonically (0.470 -> 0.557), but test AUC fell below run 4. Adding trainable encoder parameters hurt.

runs.configuration: frozen encoder + mean-pooled features + aggregated subject-level linear probe (class-weighted head)
runs.notes: Test AUC below random baseline. Whisper's frozen ASR-oriented features do not carry usable depression signal (dev AUC 0.573 -> test 0.483).

runs.configuration: partial fine-tune, last 4 of 12 encoder layers
runs.notes: Anti-learning: dev AUC below 0.50 from epoch 1 and decreasing across epochs (0.486 -> 0.466). Train loss moved only 0.638 -> 0.579 over 6 epochs.

runs.configuration: LoRA (r=8, alpha=16) on attention q_proj, v_proj + classifier head
runs.notes: Best Whisper result (+0.058 over frozen probe, +0.069 over partial FT). Dev AUC peaked at epoch 1 and declined; overfitting started immediately.
